task: optimizer convergence speed on the two-layer MLP trainer

paper.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
paper.authors: Diederik P. Kingma and Jimmy Ba

hypothesis: The logistic head has two weights and a bias, so 'Adam is mid-pack on time-to-target' could be an artefact of an almost-convex model. This runs the same question on a two-layer tanh MLP with every family retuned for that model: at a matched epoch budget, does Adam reach a training-loss target in fewer epochs than SGD, momentum, AdaGrad and RMSProp?
